description: Validate successful LTE attach procedure with a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Test setup configured as single cell with only one active UE under excellent LTE RSRP conditions.
All other cells are powered off.
End-to-end LTE setup is operational without connectivity issues.
testSteps: Configure the test parameters and record them in the test report.
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure.
Capture call flow and signaling messages starting from UE power ON.
Wait until attach complete message is received confirming successful attach.
Verify UE is attached to the correct LTE cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN in UE logs.
Stop and save the test logs.
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% for the iteration.
UE is successfully attached to the correct LTE cell as per configuration.
No connectivity issues observed during attach.
postconditions: UE remains attached until detach step or test iteration ends.
verificationMethods: Review UE logs for attach request and attach complete messages.
Validate cell ID parameters in UE logs.
Check captured signaling message flow for successful attach.

description: Validate successful LTE detach procedure with a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: UE is currently attached to LTE cell successfully.
testSteps: Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach procedure.
Capture call flow and signaling messages starting from UE power OFF.
Wait until detach accept message and signaling connection release messages are received.
Stop and save the test logs.
expectedResults: Detach success rate is 100% for the iteration.
Signaling connection release is confirmed by UE context release and RRC connection release messages.
UE is successfully detached from the LTE network.
postconditions: UE is in detached state.
verificationMethods: Review signaling message flow for detach request and detach accept.
Confirm UE context release and RRC connection release messages in logs.

description: Validate 10 consecutive successful LTE attach and detach procedures with a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Test setup is single cell with one active UE under excellent LTE RSRP conditions.
All other cells are powered off.
End-to-end LTE setup is operational without connectivity issues.
testSteps: For iteration from 1 to 10:
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach.
Wait for attach complete.
Verify attach success and correct cell parameters.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach.
Wait for detach accept and signaling connection release.
Capture and save logs for each iteration.
Record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency per iteration.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rate is 100% across all 10 iterations.
Attach latency values (minimum, average, maximum) are recorded and within expected thresholds.
UE attaches and detaches to/from correct LTE cell each time.
postconditions: Test logs saved for all iterations.
UE ends detached after last iteration.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for successful attach and detach messages.
Calculate attach latency between attach request and attach complete.
Validate KPIs in Table 5-2 and Table 5-3.

description: Validate successful 5G NSA attach procedure with single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Test setup configured with a single cell and one active UE under excellent 5G SS-RSRP conditions.
All other cells are powered off.
End-to-end 5G NSA setup is operational without connectivity issues.
testSteps: Configure test parameters and record them.
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach.
Capture call flow and signaling messages.
Wait for attach complete and secondary node addition (SgNB addition) completion messages.
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, Global gNB ID, ARFCN, and NR-ARFCN in UE logs.
Stop and save the test logs.
expectedResults: Attach success rate and secondary node addition success rate are 100% for the iteration.
UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells as per test configuration.
No connectivity issues observed during attach.
postconditions: UE remains attached until detach step or test iteration ends.
verificationMethods: Review UE logs for attach request, attach complete, SgNB addition request, and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages.
Validate cell identities and frequencies in UE logs.
Check captured signaling message flow for successful attach and secondary node addition.

description: Validate successful 5G NSA detach procedure including LTE detach and secondary node release with a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: UE is currently attached to 5G NSA cell with active secondary node.
testSteps: Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure.
Capture call flow and signaling messages.
Wait for detach accept and secondary node release confirmation messages.
Validate signaling connection release and secondary node release procedures.
Stop and save the test logs.
expectedResults: Detach success rate is 100% for the iteration.
Signaling connection release confirmed by UE context release and RRC connection release messages.
Secondary node is successfully released as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
UE is successfully detached from the 5G NSA network.
postconditions: UE is in detached state.
verificationMethods: Review signaling messages for detach request, detach accept, SgNB Release Request, and SgNB Release Request Acknowledge.
Confirm UE context release and RRC connection release messages.
Verify secondary node release message flows and resource release.

description: Validate 10 consecutive successful attach and detach procedures on 5G NSA with secondary node addition and release.
preconditions: Single cell configuration with one active UE under excellent 5G SS-RSRP conditions.
All other cells are powered off.
End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational without issues.
testSteps: For iteration 1 to 10:
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach.
Wait for attach complete and secondary node addition completion.
Verify attach and secondary node addition success.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach.
Wait for detach accept and secondary node release completion.
Record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, detach success rate.
Capture attach latency per iteration.
Save all logs for analysis.
expectedResults: Attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate are 100% across all iterations.
Attach latency (min, avg, max) within expected thresholds.
Secondary node release procedure completed successfully each iteration.
No connectivity or signaling failures observed.
postconditions: UE is detached after last iteration.
Test logs saved for analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach and detach message flows.
Validate secondary node addition and release signaling.
Calculate latency KPIs from logs.
Cross-check KPIs against expected target values.

description: Verify system behavior when LTE attach procedure fails under degraded radio conditions.
preconditions: Test setup with single cell and one UE placed under poor LTE RSRP conditions below excellent threshold.
testSteps: Configure test parameters and record.
Power ON UE to initiate LTE attach.
Capture signaling messages and logs.
Wait for attach failure or timeout.
Analyze failure behavior and system logs.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out due to poor radio conditions.
System logs indicate attach failure cause (e.g., poor RSRP).
UE does not attach to LTE cell.
No unexpected system crashes or freezes.
postconditions: UE remains detached.
Logs available for failure analysis.
verificationMethods: Review signaling logs for attach reject or failure messages.
Check system logs for error causes.
Confirm no attach complete message received.

description: Verify system behavior when LTE detach procedure fails or is interrupted.
preconditions: UE is attached to LTE cell successfully.
testSteps: Simulate failure during detach procedure (e.g., UE power off interrupted or network side message loss).
Power OFF UE to initiate detach.
Capture signaling messages and logs.
Observe system behavior and message flows.
Check if detach accept is received or if signaling connection release occurs.
expectedResults: Detach procedure may time out or fail to complete properly.
System logs record detach failure or retry attempts.
UE may remain partially attached or in inconsistent state.
System handles failure gracefully without crashes.
postconditions: UE state is logged and reported for failure.
System recovers or allows retry.
verificationMethods: Review signaling logs for missing detach accept or incomplete connection release.
Check UE state for inconsistencies.
Verify system recovery mechanisms.

description: Verify behavior when Secondary Node Release request is rejected by SN due to SN change procedure.
preconditions: UE is attached with active secondary node.
SN is configured to trigger SN change procedure.
testSteps: Initiate MN initiated SN Release by sending SgNB Release Request.
Simulate SN rejecting SN Release due to ongoing SN change procedure.
Capture signaling messages including SgNB Release Request and SgNB Release Request Acknowledge with rejection.
Observe system behavior and UE response.
expectedResults: SN rejects SN Release request appropriately.
MN cancels SN Release procedure or retries as per protocol.
No unexpected UE behavior or loss of connectivity.
System logs rejection and handles gracefully.
postconditions: Secondary node remains active or is switched as per SN change procedure.
Logs saved for analysis.
verificationMethods: Review signaling messages for rejection indications.
Verify MN and UE state consistency.
Check for appropriate retry or cancellation behavior.

description: Verify LTE attach and detach behavior at boundary RSRP values defining excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Test setup with UE placed at minimum coupling loss and at exact boundary LTE RSRP levels defining excellent conditions.
testSteps: Set radio conditions to exactly minimum coupling loss.
Perform LTE attach and detach procedures.
Capture logs and KPIs.
Repeat with RSRP values slightly above and below the boundary.
Analyze KPIs and success rates.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed at boundary RSRP values.
Success rates remain high with no degradation at boundary.
Attach latency within expected range.
No unexpected failures at boundary conditions.
postconditions: Test logs saved for boundary analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach/detach success.
Compare KPIs across boundary conditions.
Validate RSRP measurements correspond to test settings.

description: Verify 5G NSA attach and detach behavior at boundary SS-RSRP values defining excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Test setup with UE placed at minimum coupling loss and at exact boundary 5G SS-RSRP levels defining excellent conditions.
testSteps: Set radio conditions to exactly minimum coupling loss.
Perform 5G NSA attach and detach procedures including secondary node addition and release.
Capture logs and KPIs.
Repeat with SS-RSRP values slightly above and below the boundary.
Analyze KPIs and success rates.
expectedResults: Attach, secondary node addition, and detach procedures succeed at boundary SS-RSRP values.
Success rates remain high with no degradation at boundary.
Attach latency within expected range.
No unexpected failures at boundary conditions.
postconditions: Test logs saved for boundary analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling and UE logs for success.
Compare KPIs across boundary conditions.
Validate SS-RSRP measurements correspond to test settings.

description: Evaluate system performance and stability by performing rapid attach and detach procedures consecutively for 100 iterations.
preconditions: Test setup with single cell and one UE under excellent radio conditions.
System is configured to allow rapid attach/detach cycles.
testSteps: Configure test parameters and record.
For iteration 1 to 100:
Power ON the UE to attach.
Wait for attach complete.
Power OFF the UE to detach.
Wait for detach accept.
Capture logs and measure attach and detach success rates and latencies.
Monitor system resource utilization and stability during test.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain near 100% under stress.
System remains stable without crashes or resource exhaustion.
Attach latency remains within acceptable thresholds.
No memory leaks or abnormal CPU usage detected.
postconditions: Logs and performance metrics saved for analysis.
UE is detached after last iteration.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach/detach success and latency.
Monitor system resource metrics during test.
Check for errors or warnings in system logs.

description: Verify UE authentication during LTE and 5G NSA attach procedures to prevent unauthorized access.
preconditions: Test setup with valid UE credentials and authentication keys.
UE supports standard authentication mechanisms.
testSteps: Power ON UE to initiate attach.
Capture signaling messages including authentication request and response.
Verify authentication success messages are exchanged.
Attempt attach with invalid or tampered authentication credentials (if possible).
Capture and analyze attach failure due to authentication rejection.
expectedResults: Only valid authentication credentials allow successful attach.
Invalid authentication attempts are rejected with appropriate error messages.
Authentication procedures conform to 3GPP standards.
No unauthorized access granted.
postconditions: Authentication logs saved for audit.
UE state reflects authentication outcome.
verificationMethods: Review authentication request and response messages in logs.
Check for attach reject messages due to authentication failure.
Verify system logs for authentication events.

description: Validate integration of UE emulator with O-RAN C-plane for LTE and 5G NSA attach-detach procedures.
preconditions: UE emulator configured and connected to O-RU and O-DU supporting O-RAN C-plane.
Test environment supports LTE and 5G NSA modes.
testSteps: Configure UE emulator under excellent radio conditions.
Start O-RAN C-plane components and ensure operational status.
Perform attach and detach procedures using UE emulator for LTE and 5G NSA.
Capture signaling messages between UE emulator and O-RAN components.
Verify correct message flow and successful attach/detach.
Record KPIs and compare against expected values.
expectedResults: UE emulator successfully attaches and detaches via O-RAN C-plane.
Signaling messages conform to expected flows (3GPP and O-RAN specs).
No connectivity or protocol errors observed.
KPIs meet or exceed expected thresholds.
postconditions: Logs and KPIs saved for integration analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze captured signaling messages for correctness.
Cross-check logs from UE emulator and O-RAN components.
Verify KPIs against specification targets.

description: Assess clarity and completeness of test report generated from single UE attach-detach test scenarios.
preconditions: Test execution completed with all required logs and KPIs collected.
testSteps: Generate test report including configuration parameters, attach/detach success rates, and latency KPIs.
Review report for clear presentation of results, including tables 5-2 and 5-3.
Verify that all test configurations and results are documented.
Check ease of understanding for test engineers and stakeholders.
expectedResults: Test report clearly documents all configurations, KPIs, and test results.
Tables are correctly populated and legible.
No missing or ambiguous information.
Report format supports easy interpretation and decision making.
postconditions: Report archived for future reference.
verificationMethods: Manual review of test report document.
Feedback from review team on report clarity.

description: Validate attach-detach procedures with various UE configurations and test parameter variations.
preconditions: Test environment supports multiple UE configurations and parameter sets.
testSteps: Configure test scenarios with different UE parameters (e.g., PCI, eNB/gNB IDs, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN).
Perform LTE and 5G NSA attach and detach procedures for each configuration.
Capture and compare KPIs and success rates for each variation.
Verify UE logs for correct cell attachment matching configuration.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed across all UE configurations.
UE attaches to correct cells as per configuration.
No compatibility issues between UE parameters and network.
KPIs remain within expected ranges.
postconditions: Logs and KPIs saved for each configuration variant.
verificationMethods: Cross-check UE logs and KPIs against configuration parameters.
Analyze signaling message flows for each configuration.

description: Verify coordination between Master Node (MN) and Secondary Node (SN) during Secondary Node Release procedure (MN initiated and SN initiated).
preconditions: UE attached with active secondary node.
MN and SN support Secondary Node Release procedure as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
testSteps: Trigger MN initiated SN Release procedure by sending SgNB Release Request from MN.
Capture SgNB Release Request Acknowledge from SN.
Verify RRCConnectionReconfiguration message sent to UE indicating SCG release.
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages.
Verify UE Context Release message reception at SN and resource release.
Repeat test for SN initiated SN Release procedure starting with SgNB Release Required message from SN.
Capture and verify signaling and data forwarding coordination between MN and SN.
expectedResults: All signaling messages exchanged as per protocol.
Data forwarding coordination minimizes service gaps.
UE releases SCG configuration as instructed.
Radio and C-plane resources released properly on SN side.
No signaling errors or resource leaks occur.
postconditions: Secondary node resources fully released.
Logs saved for procedure verification.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling message sequence and timing.
Verify data forwarding start and stop coordination.
Check UE behavior on SCG release.
Review resource release confirmation.

description: Verify system behavior when UE fails to comply with RRCConnectionReconfiguration message during Secondary Node Release procedure.
preconditions: UE attached with active secondary node.
UE configured to simulate reconfiguration failure upon SCG release indication.
testSteps: Initiate MN or SN initiated Secondary Node Release procedure.
Send RRCConnectionReconfiguration message indicating SCG release.
Simulate UE unable to comply with part or all of the configuration.
Observe UE triggering reconfiguration failure procedure.
Capture signaling and recovery message flows.
expectedResults: UE triggers reconfiguration failure procedure as per specification.
Network handles failure gracefully without loss of connectivity.
Error conditions logged and appropriate corrective actions initiated.
No system crashes or hangs observed.
postconditions: UE and network return to stable state.
Failure logs saved for analysis.
verificationMethods: Review signaling logs for reconfiguration failure messages.
Verify network and UE state after failure.
Check for error handling and recovery mechanisms.

description: Validate that only authorized UEs can attach to the network and unauthorized attempts are blocked.
preconditions: Network configured with access control lists and security policies.
UE configured with valid and invalid credentials.
testSteps: Attempt attach procedure with authorized UE credentials.
Verify successful attach.
Attempt attach procedure with unauthorized or blacklisted UE credentials.
Verify attach rejection and appropriate error messages.
Capture logs for both scenarios.
expectedResults: Authorized UEs attach successfully.
Unauthorized UEs are denied attach with proper rejection messages.
Access control policies enforced at network side.
No security breaches occur.
postconditions: Logs saved for audit and compliance.
verificationMethods: Analyze attach accept and reject messages.
Review network security logs for access control enforcement.

preconditions: Test procedure documented as per provided specification.
testSteps: Review test procedure documentation for clarity, step sequencing, and completeness.
Verify that all key steps (setup, attach, detach, logging, iteration) are clearly explained.
Check for ambiguous or missing information.
Gather feedback from test engineers on usability.
expectedResults: Test procedure is clear and easy to follow.

Test engineers able to execute tests without confusion.
Recommendations for improvements identified if any.
